name: kb_539_Normalized

https:__kubernetesjsonschema_dev_master_.description: LoadBalancerIngress represents the status of a load-balancer ingress point: traffic intended for the service should be sent to an ingress point.

hostname.description: Hostname is set for load-balancer ingress points that are DNS based (typically AWS load-balancers)

ip.description: IP is set for load-balancer ingress points that are IP based (typically GCE or OpenStack load-balancers)

schema.description: LoadBalancerStatus represents the status of a load-balancer.

ingress.description: Ingress is a list containing ingress points for the load-balancer. Traffic intended for the service should be sent to these ingress points.

description:
Hello Team,

The latest status of our load‑balancer indicates three ingress endpoints are active. The first endpoint is reachable via the DNS name **my-service-1234567890.us-west-2.elb.amazonaws.com** and resolves to the IP address **203.0.113.45**. The second endpoint does not have a DNS name associated with it; traffic should be directed to its IP address **34.68.194.12**. The third endpoint is identified only by its internal hostname **lb.example.internal**. Please ensure that any routing or monitoring configurations reference these exact values.
